# IDS Workshop

> Build and edit ideographic description sequences (IDS), find Han characters by their parts, and
> export SVG or PNG images. The data behind the workshop is published as a CC0 release.

## Open data

- [manifest.json](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-data/manifest.json): every file with its size and type.
- [descriptions.json](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-data/descriptions.json): the descriptions with their sources, readings and groups.
- [descriptions.tsv](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-data/descriptions.tsv): the same records as a table.
- [components.tsv](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-data/components.tsv): BabelStone's numbered components and the fragment that writes each out.
- [equivalences.json](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-data/equivalences.json): the 48 kana and 10 Hangul shapes the search reads as component spellings.
- [equivalences.tsv](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-data/equivalences.tsv): the same table as a TSV.
- [README.md](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-data/README.md): the release notes, fields and sources.

The release is CC0 1.0; source-derived material keeps the terms its records name.

## Open stroke orders

Each file keeps its source's terms; this release is not CC0.

- [manifest.json](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-strokes/manifest.json): the files, sources, licences, coverage and how often induction agrees with the sources.
- [cns11643.tsv.gz](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-strokes/cns11643.tsv.gz): Taiwan's standard stroke order, from CNS 全字庫 (Open Government Data License 1.0).
- [rime-stroke.tsv.gz](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-strokes/rime-stroke.tsv.gz): Rime's five-stroke dictionary, CNS order through Extension D and its authors' data beyond (LGPL-3.0).
- [induced.tsv.gz](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-strokes/induced.tsv.gz): orders written from an equivalent character or from IDS components, for characters a source lacks.
- [entered.tsv](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-strokes/entered.tsv): orders entered by hand, each with its basis.
- [wanted.tsv](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-strokes/wanted.tsv): the components without an order that keep the most characters from being written.
- [README.md](https://ids.mkpo.li/data/open-strokes/README.md): fields, rules and limits.

Use these files instead of scraping the workshop pages.
